title: Market Hub
scope: Miami Springs and Virginia Gardens, Florida, with Miami-Dade County and Miami metro context
notices: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.
attributions: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates, 2018-2022 to 2020-2024, tables B01003, B19013, B25001, B25003, B25064, B25077
methodology: Only sources verified for public display are used: U.S. Census Bureau (ACS).
City figures are ACS 5-year estimates; county and metro figures are context, not city statistics, and appear only when their source is cleared for public display.
No individual property, sale, address or owner appears on this site. Sales figures wait for a cleared source.
Not an appraisal and not advice.
